role: Declares the overworld density pass (terrain.c): struct terrain, the ChunkProviderGenerate generator state, the Java chunk block-array layout macros and the block-id constants the terrain and surface passes write.

structs.name: struct terrain
structs.java: ChunkProviderGenerate's rand, noise generators, parabolicField, the GenLayer stack and the world seed

structs.name: BLK_* enum
structs.java: Blocks ids the worldgen passes write (air, stone, grass, dirt, bedrock, water, sand, gravel, sandstone, ice, stained and hardened clay)

notes: CELL(x, y, z) is Java's x << 12 | z << 8 | y chunk index over CHUNK_CELLS 65536.
